name: Humming Bird Education Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2010, Humming Bird Education Ltd is in the business of providing education 
and allied services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
HBEL is a Third-Party Evaluator which conducts international level Olympiad examinations, which are designed on a scientific syllabus to evaluate students against their peers. The company offers various books for the preparation of the Olympiads.

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 26.1 days to 20.3 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 12.9% over last 3 years.
